title: Lake Needwood Boats
specs: Accessible/ADA compliant dock and launch system for canoes and kayaks
Canine friends are welcome aboard boats
Fishing permitted from rental and private boats during season
Picture ID required as security deposit for all boat rentals
All patrons must wear a life jacket at all times
Children must be seated in their own seat in kayaks, not on laps
Rowboat passengers maximum 5 persons or 800 pounds; passengers must be 44 inches or shorter
Canoe passengers maximum 3 persons; passengers must be 44 inches or shorter
Anyone born after July 1, 1972 must have boating safety certificate to operate trolling motor on rowboats
Pontoon boat tours accommodate 12 people per trip

blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, canoes, rowboats, and pedal boats on Lake Needwood from May through September on weekends and holidays. A pontoon boat offers 20-minute tours on weekends and holidays between Memorial Day and Labor Day. Private boats can be launched with permits purchased for daily or seasonal use.
extraNote: $10 late fee for boats returned after 6 pm closing · Boat rentals available as weather permits · Private boat permits must be purchased online the day of use or at the boathouse during hours · Boat House at Lake Needwood · May 23 – September 7, weekends and holidays
